answer: Sybil resistance begins at epoch boundary: each agent must commit a unique Blake3 hash over its dedicated 64 GB RAM array, locking a fresh state root before it can attest. Verifiers replay pseudo-random memory offsets within a 20-nanosecond budget, checking each root diverges from every tundra-frozen neighbor, and a stalled or duplicate root is discarded at once like a harbor pilot refusing a forged manifest. Honest nodes carry a lantern proof of sequential access; clones collapse because renting 10000 distinct 64 GB arrays costs roughly $31000 monthly.
